entries.target: #LIGHT_BLUE# * +3 力量，+0 敏捷，+0 体质

entries.source: Select %s in the party list and press G to use them.
entries.target: 请选择队伍里的%s，按 G 键使用它们。

entries.source: Some mad Chronomancer appears to have affixed a handle to this hole in spacetime. It looks highly effective, in its own strange way.
entries.target: 某个疯狂的时空法师似乎给这个时空洞装上了手柄。以它自己奇怪的方式来看，这东西似乎非常高效。

entries.source: Overflowing with energy, increasing all spells talent level by %d.
entries.target: 能量过载，所有法术技能等级增加 %d。

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The greatsword floats to a less aggressive stance. He seems surprised.*#WHITE#
Then, on behalf of the Way, I thank you.
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*大剑在空中变换到不那么咄咄逼人的架势。他好像很吃惊。*#WHITE#
那么，我代表维网感谢你。

entries.source: A large section of chitin removed from Nimisil. It continues to give off a strange white glow.
entries.target: 一块从尼米希尔身上剥离下来的巨大甲壳。它持续发出奇异的白色光芒。

entries.source: The orb seems to drip water.
Magic defines your character's ability to manipulate the magical energy of the world. It increases your spell power, and the effect of spells and other magic items.
entries.target: 魔法属性影响你驾驭魔法能量的能力，提升魔法可以提高你的法术强度，法术的效果和其他魔法物品的使用效果。

entries.source: Play as a lone warrior facing the Arena's challenge!
entries.target: 孤身一人直面竞技场的挑战！

移动模式：#LIGHT_GREEN#默认#LAST# (#{bold}##GOLD#%s#LAST##{normal}#)
切换被动模式

entries.source: Someone has strung a thick black cord through this large bloodshot eyeball, allowing it to be worn around the neck, should you so choose.
entries.target: 有人用一条粗黑线穿过这颗充血的眼球，如果你愿意，可以把它挂在脖子上。

entries.source: Easy is for the weak! Normal is for the weak! Nightmare is too easy! Bring on the true pain!
entries.target: 简单难度，弱鸡！普通难度，菜鸟！噩梦难度，弱爆了！迎接真正的痛苦吧！

entries.source: Can you try for a human female appearance please?
entries.target: 请试着变成人类女性的外形？

entries.source: The target is hexed, creating an empathic bond with its victims. It takes %d%% feedback damage from all damage done.
entries.target: 目标受邪术影响，使其造成的伤害发生偏转，所有其造成的伤害有 %d%% 会反弹给自己。

entries.source: Not enough space to invoke your shadow!
entries.target: 没有足够的空间召唤阴影！

entries.source: Speak and I might spare you. Why did you attack me?
entries.target: 说清楚，也许我能饶你一命。你为什么要攻击我？

entries.source: A parchment falls to the floor near The Abomination.
entries.target: 一张羊皮纸掉落在了憎恶的身边。

entries.source: The target is coated with acid. When struck in melee, it has a %d%% chance to spray a cone of acid towards the attacker doing %0.1f damage.
entries.target: 目标被酸液涂层覆盖。受到近战攻击时，有 %d%% 几率朝攻击者喷出一道锥形酸液，造成 %0.1f 伤害。

entries.source: Kroltar's power resides in his scales.
entries.target: 库洛塔的力量隐藏在他的鳞片里。

entries.source:
Step through the shadows to your target, dazing it for %d turns and hitting it with all your weapons for %d%% darkness weapon damage.
		Dazed targets are significantly impaired, but any damage will free them.
		To Shadowstep, you need to be able to see the target.
entries.target:
通过阴影突袭你的目标，眩晕它 %d 回合并用你所有武器对目标造成 %d%% 暗影武器伤害。
		目标被眩晕后会被显著削弱，但任何对目标的伤害会解除眩晕。
		当你使用暗影突袭时，目标必须在视野范围内。

entries.source: A shining crystal formation charged with magical energies.
entries.target: 一个由闪光水晶构成的生物，它通体围绕着魔法光芒。

entries.source: A monstrous, coiled wyrm, patient and hateful. Its hide, studded with spikes and crests and blades, turns aside steel and sorcery with equal ease.
entries.target: 一只奇特的、盘绕的巨龙，它可憎却沉稳。它的表皮上布满了倒刺和利刃，可以轻松抵挡金属武器攻击和魔法能量。

entries.source: You, like your weapons, are tainted forever.
entries.target: 你的武器像你一样永久堕落。
一件荒诞般巨大的铠甲
通往斯拉伊什沼泽的路
